newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-GERMAN FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND PROGRAMME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-GERMAN FIRST DIVISION WEEKEND PROGRAMME.

text.p: German first division programme at the weekend (league positions in brackets, kickoff times GMT):
Bochum unbeaten at home this season while Moenchengladbach not scored away from home. Borussia also have long list of injuries including key Swedish striker Martin Dahlin (pulled calf muscle).
Karlsruhe expected to be at full strength but Fortuna have won away three times this season despite their lowly position.
Leverkusen are enjoying unbeaten run of 10 games but St Pauli have good record at home against the club. Leverkusen need to the points from these sort of games to sustain championship challenge.

Borussia performing well in Europe with place in European Cup quarter- finals secure but need to intensify their challenge in Bundesliga where they are three points behind leaders VfB Stuttgart. Werder unbeaten at home.
Schalke have poor record at home this season with just one victory in seven games. 1860 need to bounce back after 3-1 home defeat by struggling Bielefeld last weekend.

Bottom-of-the-table clash. After bad start to season, Bielefeld have won their last two games and seem to have more confidence. The promoted team must win this one if they want to enhance their chances of staying in top flight.

Bayern beaten 1-0 at home by Rostock last season but must win this one against bottom club to keep up championship challenge before next weekend's showdown with Stuttgart. Bavarians without suspended Lothar Matthaeus.

Cologne largely expected to be unchanged while Hamburg have several injuries. Hamburg have taken just four points from seven games away from home and have not won in Rhine-side city since 1988-89 season.

Duisburg have not won their last two games at home while Stuttgart have lost just one of seven away, winning three and drawing three. Stuttgart may give a few reserve players a run-out so that most of squad fit for next weekend's clash with Bayern.
